protocol: Three sequential fresh-process baseline/candidate pairs; a dense control pair; separate million-row profiles. Standard warmup outside fit clock. One BLAS thread, 16 Numba workers.

provenance.construction: Independent synthetic Gaussian location-scale with small feature groups

background_activity.caveat: Endpoint accounting is a lower bound: CPU used after a process's last observation before exit, and by processes born and exited between snapshots, is unavailable. Newly observed processes contribute all observed lifetime ticks; PID reuse is distinguished by start ticks. Descendants that reparent between snapshots may not be identifiable. This is a screening check, not proof that the machine stayed quiet throughout a fit.

limits: One Gaussian location/scale model shape on one machine; dense control has one pair.
Peak RSS includes preparation and warmup; fit-end resident RSS is distinct.
Row census only visits solver results reachable through smoothing dataclasses/containers, not the whole heap.
Timing median is 2.835 percent higher in the candidate; pair signs differ and no speedup is claimed.
Full training inputs and prepared likelihood rows remain; larger-N capacity and bounded whole-fit memory are unproven.
